title: Der fliegende Holländer: Overture
description: Wagner conducted at Riga’s German theater in this building from 1837 to 1839. Fleeing his debts, he escaped by sea in a storm, and the voyage gave him the idea for The Flying Dutchman.

title: Pūt, vējiņi
description: “Blow, little wind,” a folk song about a young man asking the wind to carry his boat to his love. It is sung at the close of every song festival and works as an unofficial anthem.

title: Million Roses
description: A song by Riga composer Raimonds Pauls, first written with Latvian words about a girl’s fate, then given new Russian words about a poor painter who buys a million roses for an actress. Sung by Alla Pugacheva, it became a Soviet standard.

title: Atmostas Baltija
description: “The Baltics Are Waking Up,” written for the Baltic Way and sung in Latvian, Lithuanian, and Estonian by singers from all three countries.
